title: Creative Activation Method
description: Viewer activation mechanism a CTV or high-impact unit offers beyond a rendered impression: `qr_code` (on-glass QR to a buyer URL), `deep_link` (app or content deep link, including app-store detail pages), `push_notification` and `email` (send-to-device follow-ups with buyer-supplied copy), `tune_in` (jump to linear/virtual channel or content), `text_message` (SMS follow-up with buyer-supplied copy). Activations are engagement events, never additional impressions. Formats offering copy-bearing activations declare normative character-limited copy slots via `slots_override`: `push_notification` → `activation_message`; `text_message` → `activation_text_message`; `email` → `activation_email_subject` + `activation_email_body`. The activation URL rides `landing_page_url` unless a dedicated slot is declared.
